payload.title: Require Humanus 0.34: check table cells, skip rule findings in quotations
payload.description: Humanus 0.34.0 (AnthusAI/Humanus#54) checks table-cell prose in both lanes and exempts rule findings inside direct quotations. Papyrus required humanus <0.34; raise to >=0.34,<0.35 and document. Trial stories re-checked with 0.34: no claims violations in tables.
